subtitle: Swap your tokens at the best price
card_description: Swap your tokens using DinoVox liquidity pools
wrap_info: ⚡ 1:1 conversion — EGLD → WEGLD via the wrap contract
unwrap_info: ⚡ 1:1 conversion — WEGLD → EGLD via the unwrap contract
high_impact_warning: This route has a high price impact — you are paying more than the market price for this token. Try reducing the swap amount for a better rate.
npm_cta: Own a project? Add this module to your dApp →
multiroute_partial_warning: Test feature, not atomic on-chain — each leg is a separate transaction signed together as one batch. One leg can succeed while another fails.
arb_slippage_too_high: Opportunity too small to cover slippage
error_amount_too_low: Amount too low to get a quote
error_no_route: No route available for this pair
liquidity_empty: Your liquidity positions will appear here.
liquidity_est_fees_tooltip: Estimated fees your position would earn over 30 days: the pool's LP fees from the swaps of the last {{days}} days. If your deposit is recent, you did not earn those past fees, and future volume may differ.
pools_subtitle: Liquidity pools referenced by the router
pools_swap_fee_tooltip: LP share ({{lpPct}}%) of the swap fee ({{pct}}%) taken on the input amount — same computation as the APR.
pools_dca_ready_tooltip: DCA available on this pair — create a DCA order
pools_fees_lp_tooltip: Swap fees earned by liquidity providers, based on the swaps of the last 30 days (current window: {{days}} d if the pool is newer or was recently re-tracked). This is the basis the APR is then computed from.
pools_liq_chart_title: Reserves & LP supply — change over the period
pools_liq_chart_hint: LP supply only moves with liquidity deposits and withdrawals; reserves also move with swaps.
pools_liq_no_deposit: No deposit or withdrawal over the period.
pools_tvl_chart_empty: Not enough history for this period yet.
pools_tvl_chart_collecting: First snapshot recorded — the curve will appear with the next hourly snapshots.
pools_apr_tooltip_intro: Estimated APR, not guaranteed. Computed from the swap fees actually generated by this pool.
pools_apr_tooltip_window: Based on the last {{days}} days of activity (up to 30): the younger the pool, or the more recently it came back under tracking, the shorter the window and the lower the observed volume — the figure is still unstable in the first few days and settles as activity accumulates.
pools_apr_tooltip_voxegld: Only reflects swap fees: liquid-staking yield (VOXEGLD compounds staking rewards directly into its value) isn't accounted for here yet — the actual LP return is therefore higher than this figure for a VOXEGLD pool.
create_pair_desc: To activate the pool and make it usable, the LP token must be issued. Transaction cost: 0.05 EGLD.
create_pool_ready: The pool is ready to receive liquidity.
create_success_lp: LP Token issued! Pool is now active.
add_card_desc: Deposit two tokens to provide liquidity and receive LP tokens
add_single_hint: Enter an amount for only one token — it will be split automatically to match the pool's ratio.
add_single_requires_pool: Requires an existing pool with liquidity
add_no_pool_desc: You must create this pool before adding liquidity. Activation requires 0.05 EGLD.
add_pool_inactive_desc: The pair was created but its LP token hasn't been issued yet — liquidity can't be added until that's done. Activation requires 0.05 EGLD.
add_pool_apr_tooltip_intro: Estimated APR, not guaranteed. Computed from the swap fees actually generated by this pool.
add_pool_apr_tooltip_window: Based on the last {{days}} days of activity (up to 30): the younger the pool, or the more recently it came back under tracking, the shorter the window and the lower the observed volume — the figure is still unstable in the first few days and settles as activity accumulates.
add_pool_apr_tooltip_voxegld: Only reflects swap fees: liquid-staking yield (VOXEGLD compounds staking rewards directly into its value) isn't accounted for here yet — the actual LP return is therefore higher than this figure for a VOXEGLD pool.
add_pool_empty: This pool is empty — you'll be the first to add liquidity.
add_min_deposit: Minimum deposit too low for the first liquidity.
dca_card_desc: Automate recurring buys on DinoVox liquidity pools
dca_price_range_hint: If the live rate falls outside this range at execution time, that buy is skipped and retried later — the schedule doesn't shift.
dca_receiver_hint: Address that will receive the purchased tokens. Leave empty to receive them in your wallet.
dca_receiver_invalid: Invalid address — an erd1… address is expected.
dca_quote_unavailable: Pick both tokens and an amount per execution to see the current rate.
dca_quote_below_min: The current rate is below your minimum: purchases will be postponed until it goes back up.
dca_quote_above_max: The current rate is above your maximum: purchases will be postponed until it comes back down.
dca_error_tx: Failed to create the DCA order
dca_not_configured: DCA is not available on this network yet.
dca_orders_empty: You don't have any DCA order yet — set one up above.
dca_gas_fee_required: This order is below the minimum value — an execution deposit of {{perExecution}} EGLD per execution is required, i.e. {{total}} EGLD for {{count}} executions (locked, refunded on cancellation for executions not yet triggered).
dca_below_minimum_blocked: This order is below the minimum value and no self-funded gas option is available right now — increase the amount per execution.
dca_no_route: Quote unavailable: no DCA route exists between these two tokens — pick another pair.
